assets.label: pressure relief devices
assets.service: overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system

consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: control of freeboard, beach width and decant

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: chemical release during a planned shutdown on PSV-4110

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 3 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control IMPOUNDMENT_FREEBOARD_CONTROL: the control of freeboard, beach width and decant was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the control of freeboard, beach width and decant on PSV-4110 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in governing the impoundment, specifically performing dam-safety review and surveillance. PSV-4110 (pressure relief devices) is in service for overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system. The task proceeded during a planned shutdown while the control of freeboard, beach width and decant was never verified as effective. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 27 September 2012 an incident occurred on PSV-4110 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during a planned shutdown, releasing chemical energy held as hydrocarbon.
